title: Cobblemon Shortcuts
description:
FABRIC | 
Trigger the Battle UI with 1~6 Keys and Tilde '`' to go back
body:
# What is this mod?

Allows you to use Keys on your keyboard to select  
Cobblemon battle HUD buttons (Fight, Switch, ),  
as well as Selecting the skills and select a Pokemon to switch  

# Keys
'`' (Tilde): BACK  
'1', '2', '3', '4': Select TopLeft, TopRight, BottomLeft, BottomRight.  
'1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6': Switching Pokemon, Slots 1 ~ 6  

*The keys will only active when the Battle HUD is active.*

As for now, There is no way to remap the keybind to other buttons,   
If you want this feature feel free to edit the source code yourself or  
ask me in the Issue tab in the Github page

# KNOWN BUGS (IMPORTANT!)
- Spamming button '1' (Fight) and '2' (Switch Pokemon) very rapidly before the input gets accepted may glitch the UI. This is only a visual issue and won't cause any errors.
- 2 VS 2 battle currently has bugs. selecting an attack will NOT display the target selection, then an error message will appear. It should not crash the game, but you will lose turn.
